summary:
Implemented the rich_measure feature without running tests or repository code, and without committing. Changes: rich/tree.py adds Tree.__rich_measure__ (iterative stack-based walk, four cells of indent per level). rich/align.py makes Align constrain its wrapped renderable to the measured maximum (or the smaller of that and an explicit width), adds Align.__repr__, and adds the public VerticalCenter class with render, measurement, and repr. rich/console.py sets justify="default" in print's render options while still passing justify into collection. CHANGELOG.md marks 9.8.0 as unreleased, keeps the markdown entry, and adds an Added subheading for rich_measure. tests/test_align.py gains VerticalCenter import and repr, render, and measure tests plus an Align repr test. tests/test_tree.py gains a Measurement import and a measurement test expecting (11, 19). Choices: the VerticalCenter repr follows Align's style, and the render test expects "

foo


" on a height-6 console, derived by hand. Tests have not been run; run the suite before relying on these changes.
